rationale: The field's diagnosis verifies at HEAD; their composition mis-handles a subdirectory of a linked worktree because resolveWorktreeMain does not walk up (project-root.ts:33-34); gitRootOf does not exist and must be written. #46's 'absolute paths for multi-machine' advice cannot be right on two machines. summary: P1 accepted as a NEW design decision: a relative TWINING_PROJECT will resolve against the declaring repo root, preferring the main checkout (root = gitRootOf(cwd) ?? cwd; base = resolveWorktreeMain(root) ?? root), shipped as a W3 warn phase (dual-base notice, identical policy in TS and all five hooks) then a W5 default flip; the neither-store-exists case is unruled (conservative default: keep cwd semantics until the flip).
